payments.emptyFilteredMessage: Change the filters or reset them to see every payment.
payments.emptyMessage: A payment shows up here as soon as a store order is placed. Open Orders to see your orders or add one by hand.

filters.rangeInverted: The start date is after the end date, so the date range is ignored.

wa.title: WhatsApp Pay in chat
wa.intro: Let buyers pay for an order without leaving WhatsApp (UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets) and collect the money in your own Razorpay, PayU, BillDesk or Zaakpay account.
wa.indiaOnly: India is the only supported market for now: country and currency are fixed to India and INR.
wa.viewOnly: You can see the WhatsApp Pay configurations but not change them. Ask a workspace admin for permission to manage payments.
wa.how1: In WhatsApp Manager, under Payments for India, create a Direct Pay Method and link your gateway account.
wa.how2: Give it a name and copy that name here. It cannot be created from this app, it is a step on Meta's side.
wa.how3: Save the configuration, then open Orders and ask for payment on WhatsApp on any order.
wa.how4: The buyer taps Review and Pay, pays in the chat and the order is marked paid once Meta confirms it.
wa.emptyMessage: Add one on this page to start collecting payments in chat.
wa.name: Configuration name
wa.nameLocked: The name identifies the configuration. To rename it, remove it and add it again.
wa.updatesExisting: A configuration with this name exists: saving updates it.
wa.nameHint: Must exactly match the Direct Pay Method name in WhatsApp Manager (Payments, India).
wa.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters.
wa.autoChargeHint: Send the in-chat pay request automatically the moment an order is placed.
wa.removeMessage: Orders can no longer be charged in chat with this configuration. The Direct Pay Method in WhatsApp Manager is not touched.
